summary: Crash after attempting to move item from off-hand in Creative inventory
description: A crash is caused when trying to offhand an item in the creative inventory after attempting to do so in the search tab Steps to reproduce: - Have an item in your off-hand in creative mode - Open inventory and go to the Search tab - Use the off-hand key to try and put the item in your off-hand into the hotbar (stopped as the search box takes priority) - Change back to the Survival Inventory tab, and then press the off-hand key again without hovering cursor over any inventory slots or: - Have an item in your off-hand in creative mode - Hover over any empty slot in a tab other than Survival Inventory - Select the Survival Inventory tab, and then press the off-hand key without hovering cursor over any inventory slots As far as I can tell (Not a programmer or anything, didn t look at code, just from my small testing) this happens because the offhand hotkey when pressed tries to put the item in your offhand into the last inventory slot that you had "selected" (hovered over) with your cursor. When you try to use the offhand hotkey when under the search tab, the search box takes priority and types instead of allowing you to offhand, making it the last selected inventory "slot" (I believe,) when you change back to your player inventory tab, there s no textbox anymore, so when you try to use the hotkey again, the game crashes as there s no "last selected" slot to offhand to (or maybe because it tries to offhand to the textbox? I dunno I m not a programmer) Simply hovering over an inventory slot after swapping to the player inventory before using the offhand hotkey will prevent the crash and allow the hotkey to work as normal.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Ensure you have an item in your off-hand.
3. Open the inventory and navigate to the Search tab.
4. Attempt to use the off-hand key (default: Q) to move the item from your off-hand into the hotbar; this action will be stopped as the search box takes priority.
5. Change back to the Survival Inventory tab without moving the cursor over any inventory slots.
6. Press the off-hand key again while not hovering over any inventory slots.
7. Observe that the game crashes due to an invalid attempt to move the item from your off-hand.

8. Alternatively, have an item in your off-hand in Creative mode.
9. Open the inventory and hover over any empty slot in a tab other than Survival Inventory.
10. Select the Survival Inventory tab without moving the cursor.
11. Press the off-hand key while not hovering over any inventory slots.
12. Observe that the game crashes due to an invalid attempt to move the item from your off-hand.
Observed Behavior: In the described bug, a crash occurs when attempting to move an item from the off-hand to another slot in the creative inventory after using the search tab. To reproduce this issue, start by having an item in your off-hand while in creative mode. Open the inventory and navigate to the Search tab. Attempting to use the off-hand key at this point will be blocked because the search box takes priority. Next, switch back to the Survival Inventory tab without hovering over any inventory slots and press the off-hand key again. Alternatively, you can reproduce the issue by having an item in your off-hand, hovering over an empty slot in a tab other than the Survival Inventory, switching to the Survival Inventory tab, and then pressing the off-hand key without hovering over any slots. The crash appears to be caused because the game tries to place the off-hand item into the last selected inventory slot, which is not valid when switching tabs or using the search box. Hovering over an inventory slot after changing tabs can prevent the crash by providing a valid target for the off-hand operation.
Expected Behavior: When attempting to move an item from the off-hand to the hotbar in the Creative inventory, the game should successfully transfer the item without crashing, regardless of whether the player has previously interacted with the Search tab or hovered over different inventory slots. The action should work consistently and not cause any unexpected errors or crashes.
